description: Election Commission - T. Raveendran was Selected as the Member of the manmunai South and Eruvil Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
